# The-Ski-Guru

> > Independent Alpine ski resort reporting, safety analysis, and year-round mountain travel guides by Martina Diez-Routh, covering the Dolomites, Italian Alps, and European ski destinations.

The-Ski-Guru provides in-depth resort guides, accommodation recommendations, and ski industry consulting services with a focus on Italian and French Alpine destinations. The site combines practical travel planning resources with professional ski industry analysis and mountain safety reporting.

## Key Topics

- Alpine Safety
- Ski Industry Reporting
- Dolomites
- Italian Alps
- Courmayeur
- Val di Fiemme
- Aosta Valley
- South Tyrol
- Resort Guides
- Mountain Travel
- Ski Resort Lodging
- Family Skiing
- Latemar Ski Center
- Cross-Country Skiing
- Luxury Hotels

## Site Overview

- [Homepage](https://the-ski-guru.com/home): Year-round mountain news and ski travel content
- [About The-Ski-Guru](https://the-ski-guru.com/about-the-ski-guru): About Martina Diez-Routh's independent Alpine safety & ski industry site
- [Resort Guides Hub](https://the-ski-guru.com/resorts-year-round): Resort guides hub for ski and mountain travel planning across the Alps
- [Mountain Stories](https://the-ski-guru.com/home/about): Mountain photography and year-round ski destination stories

## Italian Alps Resort Guides

- [Val di Fiemme Ski Areas](https://the-ski-guru.com/resorts-year-round/val-di-fiemme-must-read-resort-guide/val-di-fiemme-the-ski-areas): Val di Fiemme ski areas guide: 5 areas, 110km slopes in the Dolomites
- [Where to Stay in Courmayeur](https://the-ski-guru.com/resorts-year-round/courmayeur-resort-guide/where-to-stay-in-courmayeur): Accommodation guide for Courmayeur, Italy covering hotels and apartments
